name: Litra Glow
author: grant
summary: Control Logitech Litra Glow lights from StreamController.
description: Adds Power, Brightness and Colour Temperature actions for one or more USB-connected Logitech Litra Glow lights. Works on Stream Deck keys and Stream Deck+ dials, targets lights by serial number, supports an 'all connected lights' target, reflects changes made with the light's own buttons, and recovers automatically from unplug and replug.
requirements: A Logitech Litra Glow connected over USB (046D:C900)
Linux with hidraw access to the light (see udev/99-litra-glow.rules)
